name: @pacsarcade/operator-auth
description: Operator auth for puck-studio consoles — the operator IS a key, not a password: a kind-22242 signed-challenge login (PACS-CONSOLE-<ts>) against an npub allowlist, an HMAC session token in an httpOnly cookie, and an optional email seat that rides the host's fren sessions. Brand-neutral: env names, cookie name and the fren-session reader all arrive as config.
